items.summary: Image vectorization reconstructs raster images as compact scalable vector graph- ics (SVG), providing a structured and editable code representation of images. items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 review: fast, creative, and finally not annoying
items.author: Claire Vo
items.description: Watch now (25 mins) | 🎙️ My first-look at Fable 5.2: what it built for me, where it fell down, and whether it belongs in your daily AI stack
items.summary: Anthropic just released Fable 5.2, their new frontier model, and I spent two days actually building things with it before recording this. I made an animated marketing video from a single tweet, assembled a pile of unboxed furniture using only blurry floor photos, and extended our CXO brand sprites into a full bug-defense game complete with a trailer.
